issues: No factual error found. Every element of the correction matches Röhr's thesis (pp. 58-60): the taz 'TUWAT,TXT' notice of 1 September 1981 (footnote 319: taz, 01. September 1981, S. 2), the meeting called for 12.9.81 at the taz building in Berlin (Wattstr.), the signature 'Tom Twiddlebit, Wau Wolf Ungenannt(»2)', the names Schleisiek, Holland-Moritz, Gevert, Müller and Büttner, and 'die fünf einladenden Hamburger'.

Minor hedge: the thesis reports the attendance as hearsay ('sollen etwa 20 Personen gekommen sein' = 'about 20 people are said to have come'). The correction's 'about 20 people attended' is acceptable and needs no change.

Verdict MISLEADING (rather than FALSE) is right. The CCC itself calls the 1981 meeting only an 'informelle Gründung'. The Wau Holland Foundation calls him 'doyen and co-founder', though the same page also says 'Through founding the Chaos Computer Club in 1981, Wau Holland...', which is the sole-founder shorthand this myth corrects. Röhr also records that the club set up its registered association (e.V.) only in spring 1986 ('gründete der Club im Frühjahr 1986 einen eingetragenen Verein').

sourceFixes.note: Re-fetched the PDF (cover: 'Hamburg 2012', 'Version: 1.11 vom 15.05.2014'). The quote is FOUND verbatim, and so are the two quotes in the note ('Die zwei Ungenannten waren Wulf Müller und Jochen Büttner.' and 'Zu dem Treffen sollen etwa 20 Personen gekommen sein'). Context also FOUND: 'sahen sich die fünf einladenden Hamburger als taznah' and the notice text 'treffen uns am 12.9.81 in Berlin, Wattstr. (TAZ-Hauptgebäude)'. The title, date and institution are correct: an M.A. thesis submitted at Universität Hamburg in 2012, with version 1.11 dated 15 May 2014.

addSources.title: Chaos Computer Club – Club (Selbstdarstellung)
addSources.quote: Das Treffen führte zunächst zu einer informellen Gründung des Chaos Computer Clubs und wurde als regelmäßiger Treff in Hamburg weitergeführt.
addSources.note: Independent check from the club's own self-description (undated web page). Translation: 'The meeting first led to an informal founding of the Chaos Computer Club and was continued as a regular meet-up in Hamburg.' The previous sentence is also FOUND: 'Am Tisch der Kommune 1 der Zeitung taz in Berlin trafen sich damals Hacker, selbstbezeichnete „Komputerfrieks“ im Rahmen des „tu-wat“-Kongresses.' It shows a group meeting, not one founder.

addSources.title: About – A foundation in memory of Herwart "Wau" Holland-Moritz
addSources.quote: the doyen and co-founder of the Chaos Computer Club throughout several decades until his untimely death on July 29, 2001
addSources.note: Even the foundation set up in his memory calls him 'co-founder'. The same page also says 'Through founding the Chaos Computer Club in 1981, Wau Holland paved the way...', which shows how the shorthand in this myth arises.
